ValidationRule.description: For CAC Executive Escalations, the fields Contact, Country, Customer ID and Account ID are required. For reference, check user story #27296 on Gitlab Refined rule #27569
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType_Name__c ="CAC Executive Escalations", OR( (AND(ISBLANK( ContactId ),Is_IM_Employee__c = False)), ISBLANK(Customer_ID__c), ISBLANK( AccountId ), ISPICKVAL(IME_SC_Country__c ,"") ), OR( ISPICKVAL( Status, "First Contact"), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Research"), ISPICKVAL( Status, "5 whys") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: (Contact Name or Is IM Employee checked), Country, Account Name and Customer ID are required
